status.description: Reads the answer. Every other status arrives as an error body carrying recovery.

country.description: Localizes every answer to where the buyer is.

currency.description: Reads what the buyer prices in; a money row naming none means it.

gender.description: Sends it as the product spec `gender` on anything worn.

language.description: Speaks to the buyer in it; sil is always spoken to in English.

label.description: Names the address; send it, or the town where it has none, as `ship_to`.

locality.description: Says where things ship to, by town.

country.description: Says which country things ship to.

default.description: Is the address delivery is priced to when no `ship_to` is sent.

addresses.description: Knows where things ship to, the default first; never asks the buyer for it. Empty: none on file.
